author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

I've been temp-banned for spawn killing. I feel that I should be unbanned because they didn't warn me, they didn't kick me, they just straight up temp-banned me. They also have no evidence of me spawn killing. I would have backed off if they had warned me because I didn't know that I was spawn killing. I have only Spawn killed once before and that was at the beginning of April, this was only a warn. So I have suddenly been tempbanned for 5 days without being warned or kicked.

Regards,

DaCrowMan

The reason you didn't receive a warning is because you already received a warnig for spawnkilling a while ago. Therefore it's your responsibility to not break the rule again.
